independent_solutions.solver_a:
Step 1: Problem configuration: A point charge +Q is located at the center of the square base of a right square pyramid with 4 identical triangular upper faces meeting at an apex.
Step 2: Gaussian surface construction via reflection symmetry: Consider an identical inverted square pyramid placed base-to-base below the existing pyramid. Together, the two pyramids form a closed 8-faced bipyramid (regular octahedron if face angles match) enclosing charge +Q at its exact center.
Step 3: Enclosed charge and Gauss's Law: The charge +Q is completely enclosed inside this 8-faced closed surface. By Gauss's Law, the total electric flux emerging through the entire closed surface is Phi_total = Q / varepsilon_0.
independent_solutions.solver_b:
Step 1: Set up the geometric configuration: A point charge +Q is situated at the center of the square base of a right pyramid with four identical sloped triangular faces.
Step 2: Method 1 (Symmetric Bipyramid Construction): Construct an identical inverted square pyramid below the base, joined base-to-base. The resulting 8-faced polyhedron (a square bipyramid / octahedron) completely encloses the charge +Q at its exact center of symmetry.
Step 3: Apply Gauss's Law: The total electric flux emerging through the closed surface of the 8-faced bipyramid is Phi_total = Q / epsilon_0.
